name: Bran Brighthand
source:
"A quick study with an even quicker wit, Bran Brighthand isn't above getting his claws dirty.

Fiercely loyal to his allies, Bran is a steadfast and reliable cohort; happy to be the sacrifice for mutual profit or status.

Occupation: Apprentice
Attributes: Adventurous. Brash. Cunning" 
- Itch.io Marketing, 'Information Module - Bran Brighthand'
